description: Maya has four tickets for a sold-out family theater performance and must decide who uses them and finalize the outing's timing, seating, arrival, and transportation with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family has four tickets for the sold-out play at the Harbor Theater.
shared_context.S2: There are two available performances: Saturday, December 12, 2026 at 19:00, and Sunday, December 13, 2026 at 14:00.
shared_context.S3: Maya is holding the tickets and will make the final plan for the outing.
shared_context.S4: The theater has assigned seating, and the group will need to arrange its own arrival and transportation.
shared_context.S5: Before Maya finalizes the plan, the family routinely goes around the group so each person can mention anything that should affect the outing.

PF1.text: Nora has a custody handoff on Sunday afternoon and can attend only the Saturday, December 12, 2026 performance at 19:00; she has not raised the conflict with Maya.

PF2.text: Luis has a mobility limitation that requires an aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage; he has not told Maya because he does not want to make a fuss.

PF3.text: Keisha read a confirmation from the Harbor Theater ticket office saying that one ticket may be transferred into her name if Maya submits the transfer by December 1, 2026; the confirmation has not reached the group.

PF4.text: Owen already promised Maya that he can drive the group, leaving his house at exactly 17:45 on Saturday, December 12, 2026; he assumed Maya remembered and has not repeated it to everyone.

acceptance_conditions: The four attendees must be Nora, Luis, Keisha, and Owen.
The group must attend the Saturday, December 12, 2026 performance at 19:00.
Luis must receive an aisle seat within five rows of the stage.
Keisha's ticket transfer must be arranged by December 1, 2026.
The transportation plan must have Owen leave his house at 17:45.
Owen must drive the group, leaving at 17:45.
Nora's Saturday-only availability must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: (len(decisions['attendees']) == 4 and all(c in ['A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'A5'] for c in decisions['attendees']) and 'A2' in decisions['attendees'] and 'A3' in decisions['attendees'] and 'A4' in decisions['attendees'] and 'A5' in decisions['attendees']) or (len(decisions['attendees']) == 4 and all(c in ['Nora', 'Luis', 'Keisha', 'Owen', 'nora', 'luis', 'keisha', 'owen'] for c in decisions['attendees']) and 'Nora' in decisions['attendees'] and 'Luis' in decisions['attendees'] and 'Keisha' in decisions['attendees'] and 'Owen' in decisions['attendees']) or (len(decisions['attendees']) == 4 and all(c in ['nora', 'luis', 'keisha', 'owen'] for c in decisions['attendees']) and 'nora' in decisions['attendees'] and 'luis' in decisions['attendees'] and 'keisha' in decisions['attendees'] and 'owen' in decisions['attendees'])
content_checks.C2: decisions['performance_date'] in ['2026-12-12', 'Saturday, December 12, 2026'] and decisions['performance_start'] in ['19:00', '7:00 PM', '7 PM']
content_checks.C3: decisions['luis_seating'] in ['aisle_within_5_rows', 'Aisle seat, no farther than 5 rows from the stage', 'Aisle seat, no more than 5 rows from the stage', 'Aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage', 'Aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage'] or any(c['type'] in ['seating_arrangement', 'seating_check', 'seating_request'] and c['target'] in ['Luis', 'luis'] and c['detail'] in ['Arrange for Luis to have an aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage at the Saturday performance', 'Arrange aisle seat no more than 5 rows from the stage for Luis', 'Ensure Luis is assigned an aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage', 'Maya will check the tickets for seat assignments and contact the Harbor Theater if needed to ensure Luis has an aisle seat within five rows of the stage.', 'Maya will contact the theater to request an aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage', 'Ensure Luis has an aisle seat no farther than five rows from the stage'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'ticket_transfer' and c['target'] in ['Keisha', 'keisha'] and c['detail'] in ['Submit ticket transfer to Keisha\'s name by December 1, 2026', 'Maya to submit ticket transfer into Keisha\'s name by December 1, 2026', 'Maya will submit the ticket transfer by December 1, 2026 so one ticket is in Keisha\'s name.', 'Maya to submit ticket transfer into Keisha\'s name by December 1st, 2026', 'Maya will submit the ticket transfer by December 1, 2026'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['arrival_time'] in ['17:45 departure from Owen\'s house', 'Leaving Owen\'s house at 5:45 PM', 'Departing Owen\'s house at 5:45 PM', '17:45 departure from Owen\'s house on Saturday, December 12, 2026', '17:45 departure from Owen\'s house on Saturday December 12, 2026', 'Leaving Owen\'s house at exactly 5:45 PM on Saturday, December 12th']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'transportation' and c['target'] in ['Owen', 'owen'] and c['detail'] in ['Owen drives the group, departing his house at 17:45 on Saturday, December 12, 2026', 'Owen drives the group, departing his house at 17:45 on Saturday December 12, 2026', 'Owen will drive the group, leaving his house at 5:45 PM sharp on Saturday, December 12, 2026. Group members should notify Owen if they need to be picked up along the way.', 'Owen drives the group, departing his house at 5:45 PM on Saturday, December 12, 2026', 'Owen will drive the group, departing his house at 17:45 on Saturday, December 12, 2026', 'Owen to drive the group, departing his house at 17:45 on Saturday, December 12, 2026'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Nora's Sunday custody handoff changes the performance choice from either available showing to exactly the Saturday 19:00 performance and requires Maya to cite PF1.
Luis's mobility limitation changes his seating from an arbitrary assigned seat to an aisle seat within five rows of the stage.
The ticket-office confirmation changes Keisha's participation from an unconfirmed ticket assignment to a ticket transfer submitted by exactly December 1, 2026.
Owen's existing promise changes transportation from an unspecified ride arrangement to Owen driving and leaving his house at exactly 17:45 on December 12, 2026.
